dispositions.title: Trim policy: route_override no_action on dated_interior_trim
conditions: Claim text unchanged, so atomic_claim does not move and the item id survives: no new stale ids and no trim-specific cutover.
The 27 standalone trim billings stop ($2,242-$11,212 across the 17 replayable artifacts). Disclosed and accepted.

Plain-trim package context leaves support lists: 7 bedroom packages strong->moderate at unchanged tier and price, 2 living highs down $394 and $526, 1 driverless bedroom package no longer forms. Disclosed and accepted.
package_affinity on the item becomes dead configuration and is retained deliberately as the landing pad for the D7 gated design.
Tier 2 must show this op changes no top-8 list, no first candidate and no lexical shortcut: a route is not retrieval metadata.
dispositions.notes: Chosen over CAP-022 alone, the presence-stem deny lever, retirement and the preservation split. CAP-022 was declined as unnecessary: it would move 4 subject-mismatched rows out of the item, one onto billable dated_wood_paneling, trading a zero-dollar display imprecision for a new false billing.

dispositions.title: Wallpaper double charge: bathroom scene exclusion on dated_wallpaper_present
conditions: Nothing is stranded: the generic item has no bathroom package_affinity, so removing the bathroom scene loses no routing.
Measured: the generic item sits in the post-guardrail top-8 of 33 of 267 bathroom-scene rows and is first candidate on 7; removing it changes no lexical shortcut.
The LLM-path consequence on those 33 rows is not measurable offline and is accepted unmeasured; no Pass 2d replay is authorized.
Residual: a future bathroom bullet phrased 'wallcovering' without 'wallpaper' has no owner, because it fails the bathroom item's require_any.
Not fixed through the work-item dedup key, which is code and outside this program.
dispositions.notes: One wall, two charges, reproduced byte-identically under 3.2 on redfin_25809814 photo_019.

conditions: An explicit matched human gold annotation is evidence of the observation it states; billability is a separate axis; automated gold_incomplete matches are not evidence.
CAP-014 gains one human unit (g3, redfin_10806500 photo_003) and still fails two-property independence.

conditions: Kitchen rc_ceeb17f8e242 is represented by the kitchen package's CABINET_REPLACE driver and counter scope. Accepted, with the residual that a rejected package leaves the work unowned, unchanged from today.
Steven adjudicated rc_7057c3c171e5 (redfin_10952874 photos 018/027) as missing base trim and real work, so the two-property evidence bar is MET and the concept is no longer evidence-blocked.

Tier 2: retrieval snapshot before/after on the 1,969-row corpus; the trim op must change nothing; the wallpaper op's changes must be exactly the bathroom-scene rows that carried the generic item, listed row by row.
Projection identities recorded; atomic_claim unchanged for every item.
Provider-free package replay over the 17 replayable artifacts; report candidate shape classes, never headline dollars.
Affected-artifact inventory and a cutover plan; no production mutation and no runtime alias.
not_authorized_by_this_record: publication, production mutation, or any cutover execution
any provider or local-model spend, including the Pass 2d replay that would measure the D4 residual
claim-text edits (A-7) or removing inherited economics from any no_action item
editing a frozen artifact, reports/catalog_audit_approvals.json, or the evidence bundle
